reranked_evidence.title: Mehbooba Mufti
reranked_evidence.snippet: # Mehbooba Mufti. | President of Jammu and Kashmir Peoples Democratic Party |. **Mehbooba Mufti Sayed** (born 22 May 1959) is an Indian politician and leader of the Jammu and Kashmir People's Democratic Party (PDP), who served as the 9th chief minister of the erstwhile state Jammu and Kashmir "Jammu and Kashmir (state)") from 4 April 2016 to 19 June 2018. She is the first female chief minister of Jammu and Kashmir. After the revocation of Article 370 of the constitution in August 2019, Mufti was detained without any charges at first and later under the Jammu and Kashmir Public Safety Act. Mufti was the first woman to hold the office of chief minister in the Jammu and Kashmir. Mufti was the president of the PDP and was a member of the Indian parliament, representing Anantnag "Anantnag (Lok Sabha Constituency)") in the 16th Lok Sabha before she was sworn in as the chief minister of the Jammu and Kashmir.
